name: rubato-codex
description: Rubato (musical term: stolen time) model-state monitor for OpenAI Codex CLI: tails rollout session logs and the notify hook to capture Estimate/Thinking/Generating/Done/Error states per turn, and publishes the lean user-side records to EMQX (rubato/<deviceId>/state) with derived clientId Codex-RUBATO-<mac6>.
